{{Quote|We are not some cult like the Tetsu's Sorcerers of Tund.|Darth Plagueis, to his apprentice, Darth Sidious|<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''Karnak Tetsu''', also known as '''Karnak the Maleficent''', was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Offshoot]] who lived during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. They became the leader of the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] sect based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tund/Legends|Tund]].

==Biography==
[[File:Tund TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Karnak Tetsu led the Sorcerers of Tund named for the planet Tund (pictured)]]
Karnak Tetsu, also known as Karnak the [[Maleficent]],<ref name="warlords">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Offshoot]] who became the leader of the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]], a secretive group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tund/Legends|Tund]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Tetsu acquired the use of many [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] and ruled the Sorcerers via the means of terror, which prompted the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to declare the Sorcerers' beliefs as unqualified heresies.<ref name="Web Enhancement" /> [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, Tetsu and their cult were mocked by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] in a conversation with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Personality and traits==
Tetsu was an enigmatic individual.<ref name="Web Enhancement" />

==Equipment==
He wore [[Tundan robes]] and was equipped with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith talisman]].<ref name="Web Enhancement" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive, Tetsu had the ability to use the Force. They were skilled in the use of the<ref name="Web Enhancement" /> [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> powers of [[Force Enrage|Force rage]], [[Force scream/Legends|scream]], and [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]]<ref name="Web Enhancement" /> to inflict harm upon their opponents.<ref name="KOTOR II" /> They were also able to use [[Energy resistance|energy]] and [[Force resistance]], as well as [[Force Stasis/Legends|Force Stun]] and [[Force deflection/Legends|deflection]] to defend themself. In addition, Tetsu was also capable of [[Sever Force/Legends|severing]]<ref name="Web Enhancement" /> an opponent's Force connection<ref name="Saga Edition">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> and using the Force to [[Ionize|disable]]<ref name="Web Enhancement" /> [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="KOTOR II" /> Furthermore, they knew how to perform [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], and how to use [[Farsight/Legends|farsight]]. Tetsu was multilingual: they could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], [[Sith (language)|Sith]], and [[Tundan]].<ref name="Web Enhancement" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karnak Tetsu was created by [[Abel G. Peña]] and featured in the [[Wizards.com]] article "KOTOR Campaign Guide Web Enhancement 5: Karnak Tetsu, Sorcerer of Tund'. The article was the fifth installment of a series of web enhancements presenting material that was created for the [[2008]] sourcebook ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', but which wasn't included in the published version of the book due to spatial reasons.<ref name="Web Enhancement" />
